coverage_note: State personnel-system employees under the Colorado Partnership for Quality Jobs and Services Act (C.R.S. 24-50-1101 et seq.), cited from the enacted 2020 session law because the official codified text is published through LexisNexis and the OLLS title files were not captured. County employees (2022 county collective bargaining act), firefighters and local arrangements are not covered by this row. Later amendments to Part 11 are not reflected.
quote_normalization: quote_binding exact-substring is checked after Unicode NFC and collapsing every run of whitespace (including no-break space) to one space, in both the quote and the text extracted from the captured bytes (HTML: BeautifulSoup get_text; PDF: pdftotext)

governing_statute.value: Colorado Partnership for Quality Jobs and Services Act, C.R.S. 24-50-1101 et seq. (HB20-1153, 2020 Colo. Sess. Laws ch. 109)

impasse_procedure.value: Mediation with a mutually agreed mediator; if no agreement within 30 days the mediator issues a recommendation on all outstanding issues, which either party may make public; the parties may sign an agreement on the issues they did settle
impasse_procedure.quote: IF THE PARTIES DO NOT REACH AN AGREEMENT ON OUTSTANDING ISSUES WITHIN THIRTY CALENDAR DAYS AFTER COMMENCING MEDIATION , THE MEDIATOR SHALL ISSUE A RECOMMENDATION ON ALL OF THE OUTSTANDING ISSUES .

strike_legality.value: Prohibited for the certified organization to threaten, facilitate, support or cause a strike, work stoppage, slowdown or sick-out by state employees
strike_legality.quote: A CERTIFIED EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATION SHALL NOT THREATEN , FACILITATE, SUPPORT, OR CAUSE A STATE EMPLOYEE : (I) STRIKE; (II) WORK STOPPAGE; (III) WORK SLOWDOWN ; (IV) GROUP SICK OUT;

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible from nonconsenting public employees under Janus v. AFSCME (2018). The act provides payroll deduction only for dues and payments that employees authorize.
agency_fee_status.quote: For these reasons, States and public-sector unions may no longer extract agency fees from nonconsenting employees.
